correctness.rationale: For all q≥3,r≥1,n≥1, on the loopless complete graph the resting sites simultaneously fire exactly when occupancy a1=r, otherwise no births occur that update or ever again. Until first mismatch in σ=(1,0,q−1,...,2), all classes shift cyclically; if every class equals r, n=qr and state is primitive q-periodic. At first mismatch j≥1, positive class requires j+q−1 steps, zero class j+q−2; j=0 cases depend on highest occupied refractory stage. This disjoint partition gives the stated EGF by exponential labelled class weights E, E−1, h and E−1−h, and max T=min(2q−2,q−1+floor((n−1)/r))−1_(n=qr). Independently simulated original vertex state rule for q=3..5,r=1..2,n=1..7 and compared all maxima to formula, no mismatches. Finite checks support but do not establish the all-parameter occupancy proof. All-rest fixed, and primitive q-cycles count (qr)!/(q(r!)^q) at resonance.
